chapter: Kid Ory band personnel and repertoire
title: Rehearsals and repertoire with Ory
summary: Rarely rehearsed; tunes included Maple Leaf Rag, Tiger Rag, Memphis Blues, and Mack the Knife for a non-historical audience.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: Well when you were with Ori did you say you didn't rehearse much with him? Did you rehearse No

I only tried rehearsing a couple of different times and I forget what the occasion was he just wanted to get a couple of tunes out I can remember rehearsing Memphis Blues with him I think probably the band was such a natural he could have just played it right off as a sort of a scholarly approach myself you know I knew all the strains to it he just could have agreed to a structure and played it
did you play any of the complicated numbers oh
let me think we used to yeah we used to play maple leaf rag tiger rag Memphis blues
the audience at that time was not all that historically minded they just liked good music they didn't really care what the tune was and they indeed did like Max the knife
